summary: Rob Jansen died in a fall/rockslide on the Snowmass-Hagerman traverse
notes: CBN 2012-08-29 (Sunday incident): rockslide below the 13,000-ft ridge caught a group of five — two injured, one killed (24-year-old man from Connecticut, chest injuries); Mountain Rescue Aspen first on scene, CBSAR + WSCU backup; military Blackhawk evacuated several from the scene. CBN places site just inside the Gunnison County line; county kept as Pitkin from the original source — boundary-area ambiguity noted. Date corrected 2012-08-25 -> 2012-08-26 (run 149): the CBN article places the incident on the Sunday before its 2012-08-29 publication, i.e. Sunday 2012-08-26. Merge run 529: military.com 2012-09-07 HAATS article (mission 12M0531A) appended — same Hagerman Peak rockslide; Guard recovered the decedent's remains Aug 27 at Pitkin County Sheriff's request.
